title: Weight residency and offloaded prefill

sources.notes: Models ring ownership, copy-before-reuse events, missing-bank and bf16 admission, sentinel masking, tiling, next-layer prefetch and the W4A4 alternative; FlashInfer numerics are abstract.
Models the singleton engine choice, dtype failure, arena ring, event ordering, route masking, token tiling, consumption and opaque custom-op boundary; fused Marlin numerics are abstract.
Models bounded balanced selection and pre-allocation headroom outcome while explicitly preserving that these helpers are disconnected from the serving path.
CPU-only contract harness for balance, clamp/all-CUDA cases, dense sentinel slot maps, NVFP4 sizing, MemAvailable headroom refusal and stable selection; it does not establish runtime integration.

Real eager decode comparison among all-CUDA, asynchronous B70 and synchronous B70. It informs issue-before-local overlap but is not a prefill test; async and sync require exact token equality after a weaker baseline semantic fallback.
Manual all-CUDA versus hybrid+surgery decode throughput client. It prints whole-request per-token time rather than isolated TTFT and asserts neither parity nor VRAM reduction.
Real post-load surgery path/marker and output-parity harness. It prints pre/post-run CUDA allocation values but does not assert a positive VRAM reduction; the lazy surgery occurs on first forward.

Shared integration-owned source reference that selects the modeled branches and owns surgery, compact remapping, partial composition, batch-capacity chunking, per-card join/copy, CPU fallback and fail-closed missing-Tier-3 behavior.
Referenced boundary for packed NVFP4 expert streaming to CUDA; detailed CPU-stream implementation is owned by the CPU subsystem.

assumptions: Placement has already established disjoint CUDA, B70 and optional CPU route ownership; this branch models the resulting residency and prefill mechanics, not placement construction.
Small row and expert counts preserve ordering, coverage and reuse hazards but do not represent production capacity or performance.
A valid abstract partial stands for the selected engine's routing-weighted tensor result; floating-point and quantization equivalence are not inferred.
The provider slot space and host-arena global expert-ID space remain distinct even though both are represented by finite identities.
Marlin/B12x bank formats and BankSource validation are dependencies whose binary layout is modeled in the bank subsystem.
prefill_mirror.py is standalone experimental helper code because no live routed-expert source imports it.
No assigned gate, benchmark, build, lint or hardware workload was executed during authoring.

implementation_checks.description: Run the existing CPU-only helper harness to compare balanced selection, clamp/all-CUDA behavior, dense slot maps, NVFP4 arena arithmetic and budget refusal with disconnectedMirrorHelperTest and mirrorBudgetRefusalTest.

Source-inspect the nested loops to confirm every lane is issued before the first take and out[start:end] is assigned before the next chunk can overwrite take views; compare with the two ordering-failure scenarios in prefill.ryu.

Source-inspect full-versus-already-compact branches to confirm compact tensors always finalize the remap and retire the loader map, while full tensors require surgery, device and hybrid gates before slicing.
Source-inspect sentinel zero-weight masking, tile slicing, consumed-event recording and next-layer prefetch; numerical comparison must use the real bank/kernel rather than a mock.
Source-inspect bf16 admission and explicit input/FC2 scales, then compare its ring lifecycle against MarlinPrefillStreamer without asserting W4A4/W4A16 numerical identity.

Source-inspect the harness predicate: it checks token/semantic parity and path markers but only prints the VRAM delta, so a future CPU review can distinguish its asserted contract from its diagnostic output.
Source-inspect timing boundaries and confirm the printed mean ITL includes full generation wall time and no separate first-token timestamp despite the module's TTFT description.
